mcp_args.prompt:
High-key bright RU editorial collage, airy #FFFFFF, sun flare, warm hospitality mood. Comfort+ cozy apartment interiors — NOT hotel-luxe. NO host face. NO identity-real. CRITICAL: ZERO brand logos in image — no Добрый дом, no house icon, no green curtain, no terracotta wordmark, no logo lockup ANYWHERE on ANY panel. Factory pastes PNG later. NO white box/card/plate in corners.
Canvas 2048x1152 2x2; four 16:9 panels; thin white gutters.
Ban: ANY logo/wordmark/brand mark; green curtain icon; terracotta serif brand text; gold house; white rectangle in corners; dark mood; stock man presenter; meme person >15%.
TEXT: Russian Cyrillic only; exact LABELS per panel.
Top-left: bar_timeline_chart early check-in cost; timeline 06:00→07:00→14:00 gold markers cozy living room bg.. TXT:06:00 | 07:00 | 14:00. Entire top-right corner BLANK white margin 15% — nothing drawn there.
Top-right: process_flow doorstep emergency; guest with suitcase at apartment entrance phone chat arrows.. TXT:у подъезда | написать | ждать. Entire top-right corner BLANK white margin 15% for later logo paste — absolutely empty, no text no icons.
Bottom-left: labeled_checklist morning keys; numbered checklist torn paper gold checks.. TXT:накануне | время | чат. Entire top-right corner BLANK white margin 15%.
Bottom-right: comparison_table two columns правильный путь vs ошибка на пороге; torn notes gold ✓/✗; bright sofa interior.. TXT:правильный путь | ошибка. Entire top-right corner BLANK white margin 15% for later logo — empty white only. Tiny cat sticker bottom-left ≤10% only.
Inline all: #FFF/gold collage tape scraps; high-key; exact TXT; no logos anywhere; no brand marks; zero typos.
